_comment: Instance identity injected into GENERATED docs (README sections, badges) by the `generate-docs` hook. Sibling of profile.yaml, required by `pinky distribute --profile <name>`: without it the distribution stops with `no docs_identity.json for profile '<name>'`. Every value below is a PLACEHOLDER — replace them all when you copy this profile. Only a profile marked `visibility: private` contributes its org and asset host to the leak guard's identity patterns, so this public template adds none.
pitch_paragraphs: One markdown paragraph per entry. This is the manifesto rendered into each repo's README, above the generated Documentation section.
